name: Garmin Run Marathon Series – Philippines 2026
short_description: A Garmin-branded half-marathon event on October 25, 2026, at SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, Philippines, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: The Garmin Run Marathon Series – Philippines 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for October 25, 2026, at the SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, Philippines. Organized by HyveSports under the Garmin brand, the race offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km.

core_facts.venue: SM Mall of Asia Complex, Pasay

pros: Four hours to finish the 21 km, with a 7am cut-off for every distance
Chip-timed results for every finisher, published by the organiser
Big and growing: 3,012 finishers in the 2025 21 km, up from 1,843 in 2024
Event singlet, finisher's shirt and medal for 21 km finishers
cons: Humid: 28°C with a 25°C dew point at the 3am start in 2025
No 2025 route map was posted, and the 2026 race moves to a new venue
No refunds, and 2026 transfer rules differ between the organiser and a sales partner
Weather can move the date: the first Manila race was postponed two weeks for a typhoon in 2024
research_highlights: The 2026 Manila leg moves to a new venue at SM MOA Complex, Pasay City, after the 2025 edition (Oct 26, 2025) was held at Filinvest City Events Grounds, Alabang.
Assembly for the 21K is at 2AM with the gun at 3AM (10K 4:30AM, 5K 5:00AM), according to the 2026 registration page.
Cut-off time for the 2025 edition (all distances) was 7:00 AM; race categories are 5K, 10K and 21K priced at PHP 1,550/1,850/2,550 respectively for 2026.

The 2025 Manila edition drew a record turnout of 7,700 runners, according to the organiser's press release, including 238 foreign participants from over 20 countries, suggesting the series has grown quickly in its first two Philippine years.
Runner timing/results are managed by MYLAPS, and the event includes a side attraction called 'Garmin Village' with gadget displays, games and partner booths beyond the race course itself.
research_watchouts: As of registration opening, specific race starting points for the 2026 Philippines edition had not yet been announced, per the official registration partner site.

No independent participant race reports (course conditions, crowd support, heat complaints, logistics issues) were found for this event in either its 2025 or upcoming 2026 form -- available coverage is almost entirely organizer/press-release material rather than first-hand runner commentary.

faqs.question: When is the Garmin Run Marathon Series – Philippines 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Garmin Run Marathon Series – Philippines 2026 is scheduled to take place on October 25, 2026. The event will be held at the SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, Philippines, giving participants a specific date to prepare and register for this multi-distance running event well in advance.

faqs.question: What distance options are available?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance options for this event: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km run, and a 5km run. This range of distances allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to select the option that best suits their training and personal running objectives.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The race is organized by HyveSports, operating under the Garmin brand. This partnership brings together event management expertise with a well-known name in sports technology, giving the Garmin Run Marathon Series – Philippines 2026 credibility and structure as part of an established race series.
